title: StaticArray<T, N>
hints: `begin()` can return `m_data` and `end()` `m_data + N`: a pointer is an iterator, which is enough for range-for and `std::sort`.
For the `static_assert` to work, the constructor, `operator[]` and the function filling the squares all have to be `constexpr`. Then `static_assert(squares()[3] == 9);` is checked by the compiler.
requirements: `template <typename T, std::size_t N> class StaticArray` holding a plain `T m_data[N]`
`fill(value)` and `begin()` / `end()` (plain pointers are fine) so range-for works
A `constexpr` function that returns a `StaticArray<int, 10>` of squares, checked with `static_assert`
